CustomField.label: Topic
CustomField.description: ★R6 What the event is about, and the only field similarity can honestly be computed from — Event_Type__c has three values and says only what shape the event is, so "recommend a similar event" based on it degenerates into "recommend another conference". THE VALUES BELOW ARE A PLACEHOLDER drawn from the demo data's financial-services domain; replace them with the real taxonomy before this is used for anything, and back-fill existing events, or every past event looks equally similar to every new one. Multi-select because one event genuinely covers several subjects — with the costs that carries: no roll-up summary, no plain formula reference (only INCLUDES()), and report filtering is "includes" rather than equality.
